title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty to the model based on the absolute values of the coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model. How might this affect the model's variance?

title: Effect of LASSO on Model Variance
text: Consider how reducing the number of features in a model might impact its variance. Does having fewer features generally increase or decrease the model's sensitivity to changes in the training data?

title: Exploring Model Complexity
text: Think about how LASSO regularization affects model complexity. A simpler model with fewer features might have different variance characteristics compared to a more complex model. What does this imply about the model's ability to generalize to new data?

title: Impact on Generalization
text: If a model is less complex due to LASSO regularization, how might this affect its ability to generalize to unseen data? Consider whether a simpler model is more or less likely to overfit.
